hooks.name: Sync Git remote
hooks.description: After each agent turn, synchronize a clean checked-out branch with its configured upstream without creating merges or rewriting history.

action.command: set -e; git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; branch="$(git branch --show-current)"; if [ -z "$branch" ]; then echo "Git sync skipped: detached HEAD" >&2; exit 1; fi; if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then echo "Git sync skipped: working tree has uncommitted changes" >&2; exit 1; fi; git pull --ff-only && git push
